name: E30 BLESSED
role: First Car Factory prototype (Blender -> GLB). Four-door E30 drift sedan in Blessed Yellow. Gameplay handling is the Lada baseline (untuned for this car) with only the confirmed factory wheelbase changed; proposed tuning waits for an A/B test.
spec: M52B28 2.8 R6 • NA • factory ref. 193 PS / 280 Nm

confirmed: M52B28 2.8 inline-six swap, naturally aspirated (creator video description, SRC01/SRC02).
Factory reference geometry: length 4.325 m, width 1.645 m, height 1.380 m, wheelbase 2.570 m (owner-manual mirror, SRC06). Applies to the stock car, not measured on this build.
Factory M52B28 reference output 193 PS / 280 Nm (SRC07). NOT dyno data of this car.
visual_estimates: Ride height about 6.5 cm below stock, tucked tyres, negative camber (photos).
Tyre diameter about 0.58 m, deep polished lips (photos; exact wheel model and size unknown).
Front overhang 0.765 m (illustration ratio applied to factory totals).
unconfirmed_not_used: M3 / M-Tech bumper parts (community guess, SRC09).
Steering angle kit, differential, gearing, final drive, spring/damper rates, tyre sizes, mass, dyno output: UNKNOWN.

handling_notes.source: Copy of lada_baseline handling (v0.1.12+ tune). Only 'wheelbase' changed to the confirmed factory 2.570 m. Lada and RYU-32 profiles are untouched.

proposed_tuning_not_applied.note: From the research JSON 'provisional_game_profile_not_actual_vehicle'. NOT applied: needs an A/B drive test against the Lada baseline on the same course.

engine_notes.confirmed: Inline six, 6 cylinders, naturally aspirated (no turbo spool or blow-off).
engine_notes.physical_layout: Firing order 1-5-3-6-2-4 alternates between the two 3-into-1 exhaust manifolds (cyl 1-3 / 4-6), modelled as bank [0,1,0,1,0,1]: even, smooth pulse train.
engine_notes.tuning_start_not_car_data: idle 850 / limit 6500 rpm from the research JSON (tuning start); gear speeds, resonances and gains are sound-design values. Transmission, gearing and final drive of this car are UNKNOWN.

model.camber_note: Visual estimate from the rear photo; cosmetic only, no physics.

cosmetics.signature_note: Immutable showcase preset. Colour sampled from the supplied photos (#ECBF24 / #F5CB06 under different light). v0.2: deepened / warmed to #EFBA0D (owner review: the old #F2C40C read as flat neon yellow on the phone).

presentation.garage_framing_note: v0.3: the garage fits the lens to the real car every frame (90 % of the card, widest angle of a full turn = floor, up to 22 % closer at front / rear views). The v0.2 fixed garage_zoom 1.18 is superseded.
